fit_scope: all scalers and LR heads use Agent500 outer-training prompts only

classifier.learning_rate_schedule: cosine decay to 1 percent of initial learning rate

external_evaluation_protocols.prompt_matched_out_of_fold: no retraining; each prompt-aligned perturbation is evaluated only by the Agent500 fold model that did not train on that prompt
external_evaluation_protocols.fold_model_ensemble: no retraining; unseen prompts use mean log posterior across the five Agent500 outer-fold models
